creative_direction: Place a squat ivory tower at the center of a pale apricot square. Its body is a simple rounded rectangle in perspective, interrupted by one narrow vertical window and a small dark green balcony that projects from the upper right. The balcony casts a single crisp shadow down the tower face. Keep the structure compact and slightly whimsical without making it a toy house. Use matte plaster surfaces, large uninterrupted planes, and no masonry texture. A low circular base grounds the tower. The offset balcony supplies the main visual tension, balanced by the thin window on the opposite side. No skyline, clouds, signs, or tiny inhabitants.
